text:
leah: Following up on the BlueHarbor dedicated customer postmortem — quick recap: peering flap during maintenance + on-prem NAT failover exposed an isolation bug when asymmetric return paths occurred. Need concrete owners, dates, and a short validation drill.

tor: I'll take the peering healthcheck work and wire it into CI to prevent config regressions. Target: 2024-06-04. Will pair with nina on test harness.

nina: I'll build the churn simulation for staging (simulate BGP flaps + NAT failover) and add pcap capture hooks. Need a staging endpoint from infra.

leah: Staging endpoint: blueharbor-stg-peers.corp.redwood (tcp:11777). Please collect tcptrace and pcap. Also note customer's topology: asymmetric egress via customer transit.

sam: I'll own the isolation bug fix backport path and release note. Propose feature-flag gated rollout on Dedicated customers for one week.

leah: Agreed. Consolidated action items:
- tor: peering healthcheck + CI gate (owner:tor) / due: 2024-06-04
- nina: churn simulator + pcap capture + test endpoints (owner:nina) / due: 2024-06-05
- sam: bug fix backport + staged rollout (owner:sam) / due: 2024-06-07
- infra-bot: create alert for "peer_flap_rate > 3/min" and annotate runbook (owner:infra-bot) / due: 2024-06-03

If anyone wants to reassign an item, reply here before EOD Friday so I can update the tracker.

tor: FYI I'll open PR and reference the infra libs: https://github.com/redwood/networking/pulls.

infra-bot: Alert created: /alerts/peer-flap-rate (threshold=3/min). Linked to runbook: /runbooks/peering-isolation-playbook.

nina: Scheduled simulation window: 2024-06-06 14:00 PT. I'll ping oncall and BlueHarbor SRE to coordinate.

sam: I'll draft the rollback + feature-flag instructions in the release playbook and add the canary checklist.

leah: Thanks — I'll add these rows to the remediation spreadsheet and mark this incident as "recurring-pattern: asymmetric-routing" so we can track across Dedicated/Private tenants. We'll review status in next remediation sync.

nina: One note — suggest adding a small synthetic test that verifies symmetric return path for a sample keyspace; that would catch this earlier.

tor: Good call. Adding to healthcheck scope.

leah: Closing the thread for new owners unless someone posts reassignment. Keep updates in the tracker.
